heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 97–34, title IV, § 403(c)(3)(B), Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 302]

notes.text: Section, added Pub. L. 95–600, title VII, § 702(k)(1)(A), Nov. 6, 1978, 92 Stat. 2932, related to tenancies by the entirety in personal property.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal applicable to gifts made after Dec. 31, 1981, see section 403(e)(2) of Pub. L. 97–34, set out as an Effective Date of 1981 Amendment note under section 2056 of this title.
